decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that the master site has no booking system and sibling location sites handle bookings.
Moving booking handling to sibling location sites does not change the requirement to retain packages and prices across reused site formats.
The booking-host decision does not change the Smash Room brand name or its applicable site contexts.
The existing routing state already sends visitors from the master site to separate location sites, and the source decision does not alter that routing behavior.
The source is consistent with the existing separate-location-site architecture but does not change that architecture or establish a new attribute for it.
Assigning booking handling to sibling sites does not modify the existing requirements for location-specific bookings, calendars, reporting, revenue, or sales data.
The source addresses where bookings occur but does not change separate payment setups or payout handling for locations.
The booking-host decision does not change the reusable template strategy or support for integrating future locations.
The source does not alter the visual reference, layout style, navigation style, or design origin.
The allocation of booking functionality between the master and sibling sites does not necessarily change the stated SEO-preservation goal.
